title: RawFrameRecord - a vendor frame this client cannot parse
description: ADR-007. async_rithmic 1.6.3 ships message classes for five streaming templates (150, 151, 156, 160, 161) and destroys everything else. This record preserves those bytes verbatim so the archive can be re-decoded when a schema arrives, without another live session.

templateId.description: Read from the Base message, which parses even when the concrete type does not.

vendorNameHypothesis.description: A NAME GUESS from vendor protocol numbering. Explicitly a hypothesis - it must never be read as a decoded field name.

payloadBase64.description: THE record. Everything else is derived and may be recomputed from this.

semanticStatus.description: Only SCHEMA_BOUND may be consumed by an analytic. FIELD_NUMBERS_ONLY is archival.

decodedFields.description: Generic wire-format walk keyed by FIELD NUMBER as a string. Field numbers and wire types are facts read off the bytes; names and meanings are not present and must not be added at this level.

then.description: A generic walk can never produce a schema-bound frame. This is the rule that stops 'we decoded field 100064 = 174' from being promoted into 'open interest = 174' without a vendor schema.
